title: WhatsApp Events Brings People Together Beyond the Group Chat

claims.claim: WhatsApp, kullanıcıların uygulama dışındaki kişileri de etkinliklere davet edebileceği yeni bir özellik yayınlıyor.

evidence.quote: With Events on WhatsApp, your invite can now reach everyone, even friends who don’t have a WhatsApp account
WhatsApp is rolling out a new feature that allows you to invite friends and family members to events in the app — even if they don’t have the messenger installed.

claims.claim: WhatsApp'taki yeni Etkinlikler özelliği sayesinde, WhatsApp hesabı olmayan kişiler de uygulama indirmeden etkinlik detaylarını görebiliyor ve RSVP (katılım durumu) yanıtı verebiliyor.

evidence.quote: Create an event, add a cover photo, share the link, and they can see details and RSVP without downloading the app.
those individuals will still be able to see the details and RSVP without needing to create an account or use WhatsApp.

claims.claim: WhatsApp'ta oluşturulan etkinliklere kapak fotoğrafı eklenebiliyor.

evidence.quote: Create an event, add a cover photo, share the link
An event can be personalized with a header photo
Create an event, add a cover photo, share the link, and they can see details and RSVP without downloading the app.
An event can be personalized with a header photo and custom reminders can be sent to guests.

claims.claim: Yeni Etkinlikler Ana Sayfası (Events Home) üzerinden özelleştirilmiş davetiyeler oluşturulabiliyor ve RSVP yanıtları yönetilebiliyor.

evidence.quote: We’re also introducing a new Events Home that will be your one-stop to create and send customized invites and manage RSVPs.
WhatsApp will let you manage your events through a new Events Home, where you can create and send invites, as well as manage RSVPs.

claims.claim: Etkinlikler özelliğinde özel hatırlatıcılar kurma ve artı bir kişi (plus one) ekleme seçeneği bulunuyor.

evidence.quote: Keep everyone on the same page with custom reminders and the option to add a plus one.
You can use the new hub to send custom reminders and include an option for guests to add a plus-one.

claims.claim: WhatsApp'taki tüm geçmiş ve gelecek etkinlikler Ayarlar menüsü altındaki Etkinlikler sekmesinden görüntülenebiliyor.

evidence.quote: Navigate to Settings and select Events to see a complete list of past and upcoming events
Navigate to Settings and select Events to see a complete list of past and upcoming events, including the ones you’ve created or been invited to all in one place.
WhatsApp says you can view a complete list of past and upcoming events by navigating to your Settings menu and selecting Events.

claims.claim: WhatsApp etkinliklerinde, tanınmayan misafirlere kullanıcının telefon numarası gösterilmiyor.

evidence.quote: We built Event invites with privacy in mind: your phone number is not shown to guests you don’t know
On the privacy front, a host's phone number will not be shown to guests they do not know.

claims.claim: WhatsApp hesabı olmayan misafirler, etkinlik adresini yalnızca RSVP yanıtı verdikten sonra görebiliyor.

evidence.quote: guests without a WhatsApp account will only see the event address after they RSVP.
Also, guests without a WhatsApp account will not be able to see the event address until they RSVP.
